name: Latran and the Inner Town
tagline: Beneath the castle, the atmospheric heart
description: The historic quarter clustered around the base of Cesky Krumlov Castle, on the far bank of the Vltava. Cobbled Latran street winds past craft shops, restaurants and the castle entrance, offering the town's most dramatic scenery and its densest concentration of visitors.
bestFor: Nomads who want castle views and history on their very doorstep

name: Old Town Core (Namesti Svornosti)
tagline: Inside the river bend, medieval maze
description: The Old Town core sits within the tight S-bend of the Vltava, radiating from the main square, Namesti Svornosti. A maze of medieval and Renaissance red-roofed houses, it holds the Egon Schiele Art Centre, restaurants and the beating tourist heart of Cesky Krumlov.
bestFor: Those wanting cafes, sights and the main square minutes away

name: Plesivec
tagline: Quieter old quarter across the river
description: A characterful residential quarter climbing the slopes just south of the historic centre, across the Vltava. Plesivec keeps its old-town charm with a calmer, more lived-in feel, offering a short walk into the sights while escaping the worst of the daytime crowds and tourist prices.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting charm without the central tourist crush

name: Domoradice and Nove Domovy
description: The newer residential districts on the northern and eastern edges of town, including Domoradice and the Nove Domovy estates. Practical rather than picturesque, they offer larger flats, supermarkets and everyday services, with bus links or a walk into the historic core for the best long-stay value.
bestFor: Budget-minded nomads on longer leases who prize space and quiet
cons: Reliant on buses or a walk
